title: Vela project configuration
description: Schema for vela.config.json. Theme values are roblox-ts expression strings such as "Color3.fromRGB(59, 130, 246)" or "new UDim(0, 6)".

presets.description: Shared configuration folded in before this file, in the order written: built-in defaults, then each preset, then this config. A JSON config can only inline a preset; a preset distributed as an npm package needs vela.config.ts, which can import it.

preflight.description: Neutralizes the Roblox defaults (opaque gray background, 1px border) on every className-bearing host element, so only explicit bg-* and border utilities paint. Set to false to keep the engine defaults.

framework.description: Which UI library the project's JSX is compiled for. Decides which runtime a transformed module imports and how a dynamic class value is handed to it. jsxFactory is program-wide, so this is a project-wide choice.

colors.description: Replaces the whole default color scale. When present, theme.extend.colors is discarded.

radius.description: Replaces the whole default radius scale.

spacing.description: Replaces the whole default spacing scale.

fontFamily.description: Replaces the whole default font family scale. Values are Roblox font family assets such as "rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json".

screens.description: Replaces the whole default breakpoint scale. `md:` applies from the width up and `max-md:` strictly below it.

rem.description: How an offset in a utility turns into pixels across viewports.

screens.description: Adds breakpoints to the inherited scale.

plugins.description: What plugins contribute. A JSON config cannot hold a plugin function, so it states the already-resolved result instead.

utilities.description: Extra class names. A string is a list of vela utilities the class expands to; an object names Roblox properties directly, as roblox-ts expression strings.

variants.description: Extra runtime conditions, usable as a `name:` prefix on any class. Each names a Roblox attribute on the styled instance and the value it has to hold. A name that is a built-in variant, a configured breakpoint, or starts with "max-" or "attr-" is rejected.

attribute.description: The Roblox attribute read off the styled instance.

equals.description: The value the attribute has to hold for the variant to apply.

motion.description: Replaces the built-in TweenService driver behind `transition` and `animate-*`. Every transformed module that needs it imports the driver itself, at whatever depth it sits, so the module has to resolve from any of them — a package name or a baseUrl-relative path, never a relative one.

export.description: Named export to import. The default export when omitted.

base.description: Pixels one rem is worth at baseResolution.

min.description: Smallest rem any viewport resolves to.

max.description: Largest rem any viewport resolves to.

baseResolution.description: Viewport at which one rem equals base.

screens.description: Viewport widths, in pixels, a responsive variant is named after.
